name: PM-USP Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students
description: Financial assistance to meritorious students from low-income families to meet a part of their day-to-day expenses while pursuing higher studies.
target_problems: Cannot afford college fees despite good marks
Need financial support for university education

rules.description: Must have secured marks above the 80th percentile in Class XII board exams.
Annual family income must not exceed ₹4.5 lakh.
Must be pursuing a regular degree course.
Must not be receiving any other scholarship.

evidence.title: PM-USP Central Sector Scheme Guidelines
evidence.reference: Eligibility criteria section detailing 80th percentile and 4.5 lakh income limit.

rules.description: Must belong to Other Backward Classes, Economically Backward Classes, or Denotified Tribes.

name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme
description: Award scholarships to meritorious students of economically weaker sections to arrest their drop out at class VIII and encourage them to continue study.
target_problems: Cannot afford school fees after class 8
Meritorious poor student might drop out of school

rules.description: Must be studying in State Government, Government-aided, or local body schools.
Parental annual income must not exceed ₹3.50 lakh.
Must have secured at least 55% marks in Class VII (relaxable by 5% for SC/ST).

evidence.title: NMMSS Guidelines
evidence.reference: Details income ceiling of 3.5 lakh and 55% mark requirement in Class VII.
